children: Apollo-managed funds, affiliates and other long-term investors provided $585M in financing to The Executive Centre, an Asia-based provider of premium flexible office space.
The financing will primarily be used to refinance existing debt and support further expansion as demand for premium flexible office space remains strong across the region.
Apollo said the investment builds on its track record of providing hybrid capital solutions in Asia
